items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: he heard my trumpet playing and he liked my trumpet playing so we got something to go... So we tried.

ctx.x: Then after Benny that's when you decided to try to form a little group of your own. You run right into the '40s then, right? When we got married.
Yeah, but before that we tried to start a group because Mr. Vadery, Will Vadery.
